US Sanctions International Criminal Court

The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC). The ICC stated that the move aims to intimidate its staff and cooperators and that it "will not be deterred." The court described the US action as an "assault on the rule of law." The sanctions were announced hours after a former ICC judge won the Nobel Peace Prize. Some reports indicate the US sanctions are part of a drive to dismantle the tribunal.
